questions.question: Clarify Pacioli’s birth date, early biography and teaching career.

localizations.source: Clarify Pacioli’s birth date, early biography and teaching career.
localizations.ru: Уточнить дату рождения, раннюю биографию и преподавательскую деятельность Пачоли.

questions.resolution: The birth date is presented as approximate; the early biography and teaching career omit unverified details.

questions.question: Remove absolute claims about the completeness of the *Summa* and adoption of Hindu-Arabic numerals; check the algebraic abbreviations.

localizations.source: Remove absolute claims about the completeness of the *Summa* and adoption of Hindu-Arabic numerals; check the algebraic abbreviations.
localizations.ru: Снять абсолютные обобщения о полноте «Суммы» и принятии индийско-арабских цифр; проверить примеры алгебраических сокращений.

questions.resolution: The generalizations were qualified; the supported co, ce and cu abbreviations remain, while the doubtful root notation was removed.

questions.question: Identify a verifiable primary source, author and legal status for the portrait of Luca Pacioli; credit any retouching or cropping separately if applicable.

localizations.source: Identify a verifiable primary source, author and legal status for the portrait of Luca Pacioli; credit any retouching or cropping separately if applicable.
localizations.ru: Установить проверяемый первоисточник, автора и правовой статус портрета Луки Пачоли; отдельно кредитовать ретушь или кадрирование, если они применялись.

questions.question: Correct the history of Divina proportione: the manuscript was completed in 1498 and the expanded edition appeared in 1509; Leonardo collaborated with Pacioli and supplied the drawings, while the term “golden section” arose only in the nineteenth century.

localizations.source: Correct the history of Divina proportione: the manuscript was completed in 1498 and the expanded edition appeared in 1509; Leonardo collaborated with Pacioli and supplied the drawings, while the term “golden section” arose only in the nineteenth century.
localizations.ru: Исправить историю Divina proportione: рукопись завершена в 1498 году, расширенное издание вышло в 1509-м; Леонардо сотрудничал с Пачоли и выполнил рисунки, а название «золотое сечение» появилось лишь в XIX веке.
